name: create_asset
description:
Create a new Blueprint, Widget Blueprint, User Defined Struct/Enum, Material, or animation asset (Animation Blueprint, Montage, Composite, Blend Space, Aim Offset, Anim Sequence).

## Blueprint
{"asset_type": "Blueprint", "name": "BP_Enemy", "path": "/Game/Characters", "parent_class": "Character"}
Blueprint types: normal (default), interface, function_library, macro_library

## Widget Blueprint (UMG)
{"asset_type": "WidgetBlueprint", "name": "WBP_MainMenu", "path": "/Game/UI"}
parent_class defaults to UserWidget (must be a UserWidget subclass). root_widget seeds the Designer root panel (default CanvasPanel; any panel class like VerticalBox/Overlay; "none" for an empty tree). Author the tree afterwards with edit_widget (discover_tools "widget_tools") and the event graph with the standard graph tools.

## Struct
{"asset_type": "UserDefinedStruct", "name": "S_ItemData", "path": "/Game/Data", "fields": [{"name": "DisplayName", "type": "string"}, {"name": "Value", "type": "int"}]}

## Enum
{"asset_type": "UserDefinedEnum", "name": "E_ItemRarity", "path": "/Game/Data", "entries": ["Common", "Uncommon", "Rare", "Epic", "Legendary"]}

## Material
{"asset_type": "Material", "name": "M_Glow", "path": "/Game/Materials"} creates an empty base material — then author its graph with the material tools. Use "MaterialFunction" for a reusable material function.

## Animation assets — all need 'skeleton' (path to a USkeleton) except AnimBlueprint with template:true.
- AnimBlueprint: {"asset_type":"AnimBlueprint","name":"ABP_Hero","path":"/Game/Anim","skeleton":"/Game/Anim/SK_Hero_Skeleton"} — parent_class optional (a UAnimInstance subclass, default AnimInstance); template:true makes a skeleton-agnostic template. Author its AnimGraph with the graph tools + manage_state_machine.
- AnimMontage / AnimComposite: {"asset_type":"AnimMontage","name":"AM_Attack","path":"/Game/Anim","skeleton":"…","source_animation":"/Game/Anim/A_Attack"} — source_animation (a UAnimSequence) is optional and seeds slot 0. Edit with manage_animation.
- BlendSpace / BlendSpace1D / AimOffsetBlendSpace / AimOffsetBlendSpace1D: {"asset_type":"BlendSpace","name":"BS_Locomotion","path":"/Game/Anim","skeleton":"…"} — configure axes + add samples with manage_animation.
- AnimSequence: {"asset_type":"AnimSequence","name":"A_Empty","path":"/Game/Anim","skeleton":"…"} — empty 1-frame sequence (a target for notifies).

name.description: Asset name — no spaces, no special chars (e.g. BP_Enemy, S_ItemData, E_Rarity)

parent_class.description: Blueprint: Actor, Character, Pawn, ActorComponent, PlayerController, GameModeBase, etc. WidgetBlueprint: a UserWidget subclass (default UserWidget). AnimBlueprint: a UAnimInstance subclass (default AnimInstance).

root_widget.description: WidgetBlueprint only: panel class for the Designer root (default CanvasPanel), or "none" for an empty tree.

blueprint_type.description: Blueprint only: type of Blueprint to create

type.description: Pin type: bool, int, float, string, object:ClassName, struct:Vector, enum:/Script/Engine.EBlendMode

entries.description: Enum only: display names for entries, in order

skeleton.description: Animation assets: path to the target USkeleton (e.g. /Game/Anim/SK_Hero_Skeleton). Required for all anim asset types except AnimBlueprint with template:true.

source_animation.description: AnimMontage/AnimComposite only: optional path to a UAnimSequence to seed the first slot segment.

template.description: AnimBlueprint only: create a skeleton-agnostic template Anim Blueprint (skeleton becomes optional).
